messages.subject: NIMBLE development job available
parts:
Dear nimble users,

We're looking to hire a programmer to work on nimble development.  We need someone with advanced R programming skills as well as knowledge of C++.  We anticipate a commitment between half-time and full-time, from about six months to one year, depending on the person involved.  As users of nimble, we are reaching out to you first.  We'd appreciate it if you would share this with people you know who might be interested.  Since the work will be done remotely anyway due to the pandemic, there is no need to be local to Berkeley.  However, we will be limited to hiring someone who can work in the US.

To apply, please send a resume/CV and cover letter to nimble...@gmail.com.  (Don't reply-all to this message!)

-Perry de Valpine and the nimble development team
